en: Sepia-toned historical photograph showing a group of well‑dressed men and women, likely early 20th‑century tourists, posing among tall, cylindrical stone pillars and rocks in a barren landscape. The rock formations are natural or eroded monoliths rather than built structures. The people wear suits, long dresses, and large hats, indicating an era around the turn of the 20th century. No printed caption or text is visible on the image side.
